metadata.inverse_definition: An adjacent pair a,b satisfies abs(a-b)==237; either original/inverse order is included.
metadata.inference: Paired nonparametric bootstrap of query means (5000 resamples, fixed seed); intervals condition on the fixed graph, embeddings, index and sampled query cohort.
metadata.exact_control: ForwardTopKHeap is the predeclared comparison; ForwardSort is retained in the same run.
metadata.timing_scope: Timer ends after answer construction, before execute returns its diagnostic dictionary; final local Proof/cache destruction and caller-side output validation/serialization are outside the timer.
metadata.prefix_failure: Expected in-filter exceptions produce no returned list; successful-call recall excludes them and always reports its denominator. failure-as-empty recall is retained only as an explicitly defined API-output diagnostic.
